data.name: YTKACE
data.subtitle: YTKACE
data.localizedDescription: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS. No ads, background playback, video and audio downloads, SponsorBlock, Picture in Picture, player gestures and deep interface customization.
data.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.38.2 | YTKACE 1.0.1 | YTKACE_1.0.1_YouTube_21.38.2

by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.38.2
• Download subtitles with your videos
• Transcript button to copy or share a video's captions
• Added toggle to Open videos paused instead of playing right away
• Search bar in YTKACE settings

Fixed:
• Crash on iOS 15
• Prevent Open in Shorts doing nothing
• Stop Autoplay doing nothing
• Queue not appearing until the video was reopened
• Captions turning off after Playback Fix recovers a video

YouTube 21.38.2 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• `YTKACE_1.0.1_YouTube_21.38.2.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer
• `YTKACE_1.0.1_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

compatibility.notes: Tracks the official itzzace/ytkace releases. The published build follows the latest YouTube release and needs iOS 17 or newer; upstream also ships a separate iOS 16 IPA (YTKACE_<version>_YouTube_iOS16_<youtube>.ipa) on the same release page.
